note: Registry of Tier 2 claims that have a substantiation record behind them. A Tier 2 term is blocked by the linter unless it appears here with a record. Adding an entry without a real record on file defeats the purpose of the system.

schema.term: The Tier 2 term exactly as it appears in terms.json
schema.record: Path or reference to the evidence (test report, lab result, supplier documentation)
schema.date: ISO date the record was obtained
schema.scope: Which SKUs the substantiation covers, or 'all'
schema.expires: Optional ISO date after which the record must be refreshed
